title: a fetch step's place carries every accurate name, under the citation's own label
line: plan.citation_fields writes a labelled place part as the list a search step's own place field carries, the citation's own string first, unresolved or not; the runner's name-by-name try reads the citation's label as it reads 'place', every name tried logged on the run

steps.say: the 1940 census fetch step for Robert Edgar Davidson: the citation's own words, unresolved, are the one string alone
the citation's own words are already a place string of the tree (his own residence claims the same words); the resolver run with the geocoder's answer planted in its cache: a unique full match
